links.outcome: LLM screening PPV and NPV versus current EHR-based screening workflow for intra-abdominal SSI
links.effect: LLM flagged 104 cases high risk, PPV 53.8%, NPV 100%; EHR-based workflow flagged 288 cases, PPV 19.4%, NPV 100%.
links.quote: In contrast, the EHR-based workflow identified 288 cases for further review, with a PPV of only 19.4% and the same NPV of 100%.

unlisted_practices: Using LLM screening of perioperative notes to reduce manual chart review workload in infection surveillance
Cost analysis of LLM token use per case

screen.reason: Retrospective validation study evaluating a locally hosted LLM for surveillance/screening of intra-abdominal surgical site infections from clinical notes compared to traditional EHR surveillance.
